class.name: AnchoredPose
class.brief_description: A pose of some bones, kept relative to an anchor, that can be saved and shared.
class.description: Holds what an [AnchoredPoseModifier3D] puts a skeleton in: a [Transform3D] for each of some bones. A bone with no parent bone (the target bone of an IK chain) is stored relative to the anchor, unless it is listed in [member body_bones]. Any other bone is stored as its local pose. Make one in the editor with the modifier's [code]editing[/code] mode and its "Write the pose into the resource" button, save it as a file, and use it on any number of [PoseTarget3D] nodes.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every bone from the pose.

method.name: get_bone
method.description: Returns the stored transform of [param bone].

method.name: get_bone_names
method.description: Returns the names of the bones in the pose.

method.name: has_bone
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param bone] is in the pose.

method.name: set_bone
method.description: Stores [param transform] for [param bone]: relative to the anchor for a bone without a parent (unless it is a body bone), the local pose for any other bone.

members.member: Bones without a parent that stay where they are stored in the skeleton's space (they follow the body), instead of following the anchor. An elbow's pole target is usually one.
Bone name to [Transform3D]. Use the methods to change it.
